description: Flat metadata schema for individual confocal laser scanning microscopy records from neuronal culture synapse imaging experiments, emphasizing sample preparation, pharmacological treatment, and imaging acquisition settings.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or imaging instance.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biological specimen, culture well, coverslip, or dish associated with the image.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the broader experiment or study batch.

sample_type.descr: Biological sample type; e.g., primary neuronal culture, dissociated neuron culture, organotypic culture.

species.descr: Source species of the neurons; e.g., Rattus norvegicus, Mus musculus.

strain.descr: Animal strain or line used to derive the primary neurons, if known.

sex.descr: Sex of donor animals; acceptable values include male, female, mixed, unknown.

donor_age_days.descr: Age of donor animal at tissue collection, in days.

brain_region.descr: Brain region used for neuronal dissociation; e.g., hippocampus, cortex, striatum.

cell_type.descr: Primary neuron subtype or mixed culture composition; e.g., cortical neurons, hippocampal neurons.

culture_system.descr: Culture format; e.g., primary dissociated culture, co-culture, on coverslip, on glass-bottom dish.

culture_start_date.descr: Date when the neuronal culture was initiated or plated.

days_in_vitro.descr: Age of the culture at the time of imaging, in days in vitro (DIV).

substrate_coating.descr: Surface coating used for cell attachment; e.g., poly-D-lysine, laminin, poly-L-ornithine.

fixation_method.descr: Fixation reagent and protocol used before imaging, if applicable; e.g., 4% paraformaldehyde.

permeabilization_method.descr: Permeabilization reagent and conditions, if used for staining; e.g., Triton X-100 0.1%.

blocking_reagent.descr: Blocking reagent used before immunostaining, if applicable.

staining_target.descr: Primary structural or molecular target imaged; e.g., postsynaptic density proteins, synaptic junction markers.

marker_names.descr: Immunolabels or fluorescent markers used; e.g., PSD-95, synapsin, Homer1, MAP2, GFP.

labeling_method.descr: Labeling approach used; e.g., immunofluorescence, transgenic fluorescence, dye loading.

antibody_primary_name.descr: Name or target of the primary antibody, if applicable.

antibody_primary_vendor.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the primary antibody, if applicable.

antibody_primary_catalog.descr: Catalog number of the primary antibody, if applicable.

antibody_primary_host.descr: Host species of the primary antibody, if applicable; e.g., rabbit, mouse, chicken.

antibody_primary_dilution.descr: Working dilution or concentration of the primary antibody, as reported.

antibody_secondary_name.descr: Name or target of the secondary antibody, if applicable.

antibody_secondary_vendor.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the secondary antibody, if applicable.

antibody_secondary_catalog.descr: Catalog number of the secondary antibody, if applicable.

antibody_secondary_dilution.descr: Working dilution or concentration of the secondary antibody, as reported.

pharmacological_treatment.descr: Name of the neurotransmitter receptor antagonist or other treatment applied; e.g., NMDA receptor antagonist, AMPA receptor antagonist.

treatment_target_pathway.descr: Neurotransmitter receptor or pathway targeted by the treatment; e.g., glutamatergic, GABAergic, cholinergic.

treatment_compound_name.descr: Specific compound name used for treatment; e.g., APV, CNQX, bicuculline.

treatment_concentration.descr: Final treatment concentration, with unit implied in the description if available; e.g., µM.

treatment_unit.descr: Unit for treatment concentration; e.g., uM, nM, mg/mL.

treatment_duration_min.descr: Duration of pharmacological exposure before imaging or fixation, in minutes.

treatment_application_timepoint.descr: Relative timepoint of treatment application; e.g., before imaging, during incubation, prior to fixation.

vehicle_control.descr: Vehicle used for control samples; e.g., DMSO, saline, water.

imaging_date.descr: Date when the image acquisition was performed.

microscope_type.descr: Microscopy modality; expected value here is confocal laser scanning microscopy.

microscope_model.descr: Model name or number of the microscope system.

laser_wavelengths_nm.descr: Excitation laser wavelength(s) used, in nanometers; if multiple, record as a comma-separated string.

laser_power_percent.descr: Laser power at the sample or setting value as recorded, expressed as percent if available.

detector_type.descr: Detector type used; e.g., PMT, HyD, GaAsP.

emission_filter_set.descr: Emission filter or spectral detection range used.

objective_numerical_aperture.descr: Numerical aperture of the objective lens.

objective_immersion_medium.descr: Immersion medium for the objective; e.g., oil, water, glycerol.

pinhole_diameter_au.descr: Confocal pinhole size in Airy units.

pixel_size_um.descr: Pixel size in micrometers in the x-y plane.

z_step_um.descr: Distance between consecutive optical sections in micrometers.

number_of_z_slices.descr: Number of optical sections in the 3D reconstruction.

scan_mode.descr: Acquisition scan mode; e.g., sequential, resonant, line average.

scan_speed.descr: Relative scan speed or dwell setting used during acquisition.

averaging_count.descr: Number of line or frame averages applied during acquisition.

gain_setting.descr: Detector gain or amplification setting used.

acquisition_software.descr: Software used to acquire the images; e.g., vendor acquisition suite and version.

analysis_software.descr: Software used for post-acquisition processing or analysis, if applicable.

deconvolution_applied.descr: Whether deconvolution or other restoration was applied to the image data.

image_processing_pipeline.descr: Brief description of any processing applied after acquisition; e.g., background subtraction, deconvolution, normalization.

synaptic_structure_focused.descr: Specific synaptic compartment or structure of interest; e.g., postsynaptic density, synaptic cleft, spine head.

quantification_measure.descr: Primary morphological metric intended for analysis; e.g., synapse area, PSD thickness, spine density.

file_name.descr: Name of the associated image file.

file_path.descr: Relative or absolute path to the image file or dataset.

checksum.descr: File checksum or hash for integrity verification.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the record, such as deviations from protocol or imaging artifacts.
